description: Search mvideo.ru, browse a category, or fetch full details for specific products.

brands.description: Only return products from these brands. Accepts brand names or mvideo.ru slugs (e.g. `Samsung`, `samsung`, `LG`). The matching facet is resolved from the live response, so no hardcoded IDs are needed. Multiple values are OR'd together.
brands.title: Brands (mode=search / byCategory)

category.description: Top-level mvideo.ru category to browse. Use `categoryUrl` for any sub-category not listed here.
enumTitles: Запчасти и аксессуары для садовой техники
Коды для фильмов, музыки и книг
category.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

categoryUrl.description: Overrides `category`. Accepts a full mvideo.ru category URL (e.g. https://www.mvideo.ru/televizory-i-cifrovoe-tv-1/televizory-65) or a bare numeric category ID, for sub-categories not in the dropdown.
categoryUrl.title: Custom category URL or ID (mode=byCategory)

city.description: Russian city name or mvideo city ID (e.g. Москва, Санкт-Петербург, CityCZ_975). City changes stock availability, pickup stores and delivery dates.
city.title: City

condition.description: Filter by item condition. The matching facet is resolved from the live response; if it is unavailable for a query/category, the run stops with a clear message instead of returning unfiltered results.
condition.title: Condition (mode=search / byCategory)

failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as failed when zero records are emitted (for example a blocked connection or an empty query).
failOnEmpty.title: Fail when nothing is found

fromAbroad.description: Only return parallel-import listings. Applies to search mode only; ignored in category mode.
fromAbroad.title: Parallel import only (mode=search)

includeOtherOffers.description: Fetch the seller/buybox block and attach `otherOffers[]` with prices and seller details when available.
includeOtherOffers.title: Include other seller offers (mode=productDetails)

includeStoreStock.description: Fetch per-store pickup availability for the selected city and attach a `stores[]` list.
includeStoreStock.title: Include store stock (mode=productDetails)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (products, or review rows in mode=reviews). Search covers the full result set across all pages, de-duplicated by product ID. Use 0 for all (up to the 10,000 cap).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this (sale price, in Russian rubles). Applied server-side in search/category mode and client-side for detail records.
maxPrice.title: Max price (RUB)

maxReviews.description: Reviews to fetch per product in mode=productDetails (attached as `reviews[]`) and mode=reviews (one row per review). Paginated 20 at a time; 0 skips review fetching.
maxReviews.title: Max customer reviews per product

minDiscount.description: Drop products with a smaller discount than this (0-99 percent). Applied after catalog fetches (the API has no discount facet). Products without a discount are excluded when this filter is set.
minDiscount.title: Min discount (%)

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this (sale price, in Russian rubles). Applied server-side in search/category mode and client-side for detail records.
minPrice.title: Min price (RUB)

minRating.description: Drop products with a customer rating below this (0-5 stars). Applied after catalog fetches (the API has no rating facet). Products with no rating are excluded when this filter is set.
minRating.title: Min rating

enumTitles: Fetch customer reviews by product URL/ID
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: mvideo.ru product URLs (e.g. https://www.mvideo.ru/products/televizor-...-401211841) or bare numeric product IDs. Used by productDetails and reviews modes.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs (mode=productDetails / reviews)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor connects directly first and only escalates to Apify Proxy if mvideo.ru blocks a request. Change this only if you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Free-text product search, e.g. телевизор, ноутбук, холодильник. The full result set is paginated automatically.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

sellers.description: Only return products from these marketplace sellers. Accepts seller names or mvideo.ru seller slugs (e.g. `BQ.ru`, `bqru`). The seller facet exists in category browsing only; the search response has no seller facet, so a search run with sellers set stops with a clear message. Multiple values are OR'd together.
sellers.title: Sellers (mode=byCategory)

sortOrder.description: Result ordering. Only popularity and price ordering are supported by the source; other orderings are not promised.
sortOrder.title: Sort order (mode=search / byCategory)

storeLimit.description: Cap on `stores[]` entries per product when store stock is included.
storeLimit.title: Max stores per product

title: M.Video Scraper Input
